en: A vintage black-and-white postcard showing a quiet street lined with grand, ornate buildings. The street is tree-lined, with a clear view down its length. On the left, there is a striking building with a pointed tower roof, decorative windows, and a fence; on the right, another large building with a classical facade. The upper-right corner contains printed text in German that reads 'Hermannstadt' and 'Seilergasse.' Handwritten German text is also visible.
